unit.explanation: Each unit is a patient with evaluable clinical response and matched organoid drug assay

platform.explanation: Assay uses patient-derived lung cancer organoids cultured on InSMAR-chip

readout.explanation: Drug sensitivity measured via alamarBlue cell viability assay, reported as binary sensitive/resistant call

direction.explanation: Lower IC50 / higher viability reduction corresponds to treatment sensitivity

threshold_rule.explanation: Sensitivity threshold based on clinically relevant Cmax/Ctrough concentrations of each drug

threshold_timing.explanation: Concentration thresholds are established clinical values, not optimized on this study cohort

patient_mapping.explanation: Each organoid line is uniquely matched to one individual patient, as described in the article text

regimen_match.explanation: Drugs tested in the organoid assay exactly match the clinical treatment received by the patient

n_units.explanation: 10 evaluable patients, as explicitly stated in the article text

split.explanation: All evaluable patients are part of the same prospective study cohort, no held-out test split

headline.blocked_reason: Row-level assay sensitivity results for all 10 evaluable patients are not available in the previewed source data; only aggregate accuracy is reported in the article text, with no individual assay score references extractable from the provided data snippets.

notes: The article explicitly reports 100% accuracy (1.0) for 10 evaluable patients, but individual assay sensitivity values for 3 of the 10 patients could not be mapped to valid source references from the available data previews, preventing full row-level record validation.
